verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration provider, so a self-serve O-1/EB-1 eligibility tool is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only attorney-led guidance: telling clients upfront whether a case qualifies and helping them choose a path. Nothing in the pack documents a free, structured, self-serve qualifier or assessment tool on the site.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
